text: 想把刚才发出的提示词改一下再重新问。
DSH 某轮回答失败了，能从那条消息重新试一次吗？
希望重试对话时保留原来的会话记录。
让 DSH 在失败或没有回复时提供继续当前会话的操作。
I want to retry a finished chat turn from its original prompt.
Let me edit an earlier prompt in a new conversation branch.
dsh-rewind-retry 的功能「重试提示词」：为用户发起的已结束轮次创建会话分支，并在分支中重新发送原提示词文本。点击轮次操作栏的重试按钮触发；带附件时会把文本暂存到输入框并提示重新添加附件。
dsh-rewind-retry 的功能「编辑提示词」：在原提示词之前分叉会话，并将提示词放入新分支的输入框，供用户修改后发送。点击已结束用户轮次的编辑按钮触发。
dsh-rewind-retry 的功能「继续中断轮次」：在最新失败或没有回复的轮次中，向当前会话发送固定的继续提示，保留已有会话工作。通过轮次尾部的继续按钮触发。
dsh-rewind-retry 为 DSH Web 聊天增加已结束轮次的重试、编辑和继续操作。插件在对话操作栏或轮次尾部显示按钮：重试会在原提示词前分叉会话并重新发送文本；编辑会分叉并把提示词放入新会话输入框；继续可恢复最新失败或无回复的轮次。原会话保留为独立分支。适合需要修正提示词或恢复中断对话的 DSH 用户。无需额外密钥或外部服务；附件需手动重新添加。

dsh-rewind-retry adds retry, edit, and continue to finished DSH Web turns. Retry forks before a prompt and resends it; Edit forks and stages it in a new composer; Continue resumes the latest failed or reply-less turn. The original session stays intact. No key is needed; reattach files.
能不能把失败前的提示词放到新分支里再修改？
想继续最新一轮没有生成回答的会话。

@local/dsh-rewind-retry README · dsh-rewind-retry：A [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that adds **Retry**, **Edit prompt**, and **Continue** actions to finished turns in the Web / Desktop chat UI.

DSH has no built-in way to edit your last message or retry a turn that failed (for example, one halted by a network error). This plugin adds those actions.

@local/dsh-rewind-retry README · Actions：| Action | Where | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| ↺ **Retry** | every finished turn you started with a prompt | Forks the session right before that prompt and sends the same prompt again in the fork. |
| ✎ **Edit** | same | Forks at the same point and puts the old prompt into the fork's composer so you can change it before sending. |
| ⏭ **Continue** | latest turn only, when it failed or produced no reply | Sends "Continue from where you left off." in the **same** session, keeping all work already done. |

@local/dsh-rewind-retry README · Actions：Turns that ended with a reply get the actions as icons in the existing copy / branch row (revealed on hover, like the built-in icons). Turns that ended without a reply, such as failed or stopped turns, get a visible row of labelled buttons, because DSH shows no action row for them.

@local/dsh-rewind-retry README · How it works：DSH's session log is append-only, so a "rewind" is a **fork**: the plugin calls the Host's `session.fork` with an exact `atSeq` boundary and opens the new session. The original session is kept as a branch. Rewinding only affects the conversation; files changed on disk stay changed.

Choosing the boundary (`planRewind` in [`client.js`](client.js)):

@local/dsh-rewind-retry README · Limitations：- **Attachments aren't carried over.** Retry resends text only. If the original prompt had images or files, Retry stages the text in the composer (like Edit) and shows a note to attach them again.
- **Where the actions appear.** They sit at the end of each turn, because DSH offers no extension slot on the user-message bubble.
- **Which turns are rewindable.** Only turns started by your own prompt. Turns started by goal rounds, schedules, or subagent notices get no Retry or Edit.
- **Tested version.** Only tested against DSH `0.1.7-rc.1`. The plugin reads some Client internals (the chat snapshot and the session event window) defensively, but a future DSH release may still need updates.

@local/dsh-rewind-retry README · Development：| File | Role |
|---|---|
| [`client.js`](client.js) | Browser half: slot registrations, UI, and the pure planning logic. |
| [`index.js`](index.js) | Host half. Empty, because the plugin uses only existing Host Remotes (`session.fork`, `session.prompt`, `session.updateQueue`). |
| [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml) | Bundle patch that inserts the plugin row. |
| [`locale/`](locale) | Display title and description shown in the Plugin Manager. |

@local/dsh-rewind-retry README · Development：The repo uses [pnpm](https://pnpm.io) (pinned through `packageManager` in `package.json`).

```sh
pnpm install      # no runtime dependencies yet; creates the local environment
pnpm test         # unit tests for the fork-boundary planner (node:test)
pnpm run check    # syntax check + tests
